scope: Editor authority and two independent headless RPC owners.16 supported paired routes use native capsule sweeps; ladder/rope contention and Root/Stun interruption use actual-clock body movement. Rope binding is explicit existing-item fixture staging; separate portable suite covers binding RPC. No rendered, packaged-server, occupancy stress or whole-stage acceptance.
